investment_theses.thesis: Oil/energy volatility (via USO, crude futures) outperforms stocks through Q3 2026 as Iran-Hormuz escalation + Trump Russia diesel deal create structural supply uncertainty.
supporting_signals: Brent crude touches $110 on Iran Hormuz attacks (CNBC); first material spike in 4 months.
Trump diesel deal adds geopolitical x-factor—policy support for Russia may lock in higher structural oil prices.
Ukrainian refinery strikes threaten Russian output; tit-for-tat escalation pattern typically sustains $100–120 range.
investment_theses.counter_view: Global recession fears + demand destruction from higher rates could collapse oil to $70–80; Trump's deal may stabilize Russia without creating new scarcity.
investment_theses.expression: Long crude oil (CL futures or USO ETF); short SPY or pair trade USO +3x / QQQ -1x.

investment_theses.thesis: VIX vol-of-vol is structurally bid into mid-2026; equity hedges and tail-risk calls outperform as AI narrative crack + macro uncertainty (deficit, Fed policy) push realized vol higher than forward vega pricing.
supporting_signals: VIX above 22 for first time in 4 months on AI sell-off (CNBC); cluster of trader bets suggests momentum to 28+.
Budget deficit swells to $2T (+12% YoY)—fiscal sustainability debate reignites hawkish repricing.
Altcoin outperformance (TIA +16%) masks fragility in mega-cap momentum (NVDA, TSLA); rotation risk is acute.
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed cuts rates into summer 2026 to defend equity market; volatility crush as safe havens rally and hedgers capitulate on costs.
investment_theses.expression: Long VIX calls (Jun/Jul 2026 28 strike) or long short-duration equity put spreads; pair with short VIX term structure (sell front-month, hold back).

investment_theses.thesis: Quantum computing risk (Google Willow + Quantum Alliance) will force BTC protocol reassessment by Q4 2026, triggering 5–15% draw-down in BTC but structural re-rating into quantum-resistant narrative via altcoins (ZEC, NEAR).
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Google Willow cracks NSA mystery; 6.4M BTC face quantum threat; Satoshi-era addresses at highest risk.
Hacker News consensus (Claude ECDSA discussion, 856 upvotes) signals serious technical community engagement.
Quantum Alliance formation is institutional legitimacy for an academic concern—media and retail FOMO cycle likely follows.
investment_theses.counter_view: Post-quantum cryptography migration is 5–10 year problem; BTC community (full nodes, consensus) unlikely to fork before 2028+; market prices zero material risk in 2026.
investment_theses.expression: Short BTC spot or BTC perps (-5% to -15% target); long ZEC and NEAR spot; pair trade BTC/ETH ratio short (BTC underperforms ETH on quantum narrative).

investment_theses.thesis: Stablecoin adoption (USDC, USDT) accelerates via remittance/cross-border rails (84% cost savings signal) and Circle's 40-market expansion; DXY weakness + elevated carry yields make USDC lending yield (Aave, Compound) 4–6% ARR attractive vs. treasuries.
supporting_signals: Circle targets 40 new markets; stablecoin remittance report shows 84% cost advantage vs. traditional.
Lagarde digital euro imminent—regulatory green-light narrative strengthens broader CBDC/stablecoin legitimacy.
Crypto PAC spending (Sherrod Brown race) signals institutional confidence in crypto infrastructure durability.
investment_theses.counter_view: Regulatory clawback (U.S. stablecoin bill) or Circle business model pressure (lower lending spreads) could reverse yield compression; remittance adoption slower than projected.
investment_theses.expression: Long USDC staking/lending (6% yield target); long Polymarket/Kalshi USDC volume growth contracts; short DXY (anticipate further USD weakness into 2027).
